name: claude-research-junior
description: Complete AI-assisted scientific paper writing system — from literature discovery to polished manuscript. Bundles CrystaLit (literature crystallization pipeline), strategic paper scoping, skeleton building, figure planning, scientific-writing prose style, multi-round polishing, and a reusable expert panel discussion agent. Uses plain Markdown [@citekey] citations with your own bibliography — no external citation dependency. Built for medical AI research teams using Zotero, Pandoc, and VS Code.
